Himachal Pradesh Government to Refund Fees for Cancelled Recruitment Exams

The Himachal Pradesh government has decided to refund application fees totaling Rs 4.27 crore to 3.41 lakh candidates whose Himachal Pradesh Staff Selection Commission (HPSSC) recruitment exams were cancelled. This decision comes after the cancellation of these recruitment processes. The refunds are intended for candidates who had applied and paid fees for the cancelled examinations.
